The Story

Real science. No corporate agenda.

I'm a food scientist and sports nutrition coach, and I built VeraFuel because I couldn't find a sports nutrition app that actually understood plant-based training.

Most either ignored the diet entirely or ignored the training, nobody connected the two.

It's a solo project, built in my own time alongside a full-time job in food development. Just better fuelling for real athletes, built by one person, not a company chasing a valuation.

MSc Food Science Level 4 Elite Sports Nutrition Endurance Athlete Built solo
Real Food. Real Performance.

Food first, always.

VeraFuel takes a food-first approach to sports nutrition, helping you understand how real food can fuel training, support recovery and cover the nutritional needs of a plant-based athlete.

Plant-Based Sports Nutrition

Plant-based sports nutrition, without the guesswork.

Plant-based athletes have the same performance goals as everyone else, but nutrition can require a little more thought.

VeraFuel helps vegan, vegetarian and plant-forward athletes understand their protein, iron, carbohydrates, micronutrients, recovery and overall fuelling alongside their training.
